lines.text: It shouts louder than the facts.
But this time… someone answers back.
Every announcement, seen before it lands.

lines.tts: Four hundred and sixty-two ideas tested. Six survived.

lines.text: And before every trade… the green light.
MACROARSENAL. On January 11, the noise stops.
lines.tts: Macro Arsenal. On January eleventh, the noise stops.

voices.label: EN, deep and warm (animated film)
voices.design: A deep, warm British male narrator in his fifties, rich velvety bass voice like the trailers of big family animated movies: resonant but friendly, a hint of a smile and a sense of wonder. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, natural breathing and tiny imperfections, never robotic, never synthetic.

voices.label: EN, very deep and epic
voices.design: A very deep, booming American male movie trailer narrator in his forties, huge chest resonance and slow gravitas, the voice of epic blockbuster teasers, with a slight natural grain. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, natural breathing, organic, never robotic, never synthetic.

voices.label: EN, deep, playful and modern
voices.design: A deep, modern British male voice-over artist in his thirties with a low, smooth and slightly playful tone, confident and cool, like the narrator of a bold tech product launch with humour. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, relaxed and conversational, never robotic, never synthetic.

acting: Read it like the voice-over of a punchy animated movie teaser: deep, calm and confident, short sentences that land on the beat, real pauses between sentences. Slightly mysterious at the start, a knowing smile on « someone answers back », energy rising through the list, and a big, warm, unforgettable final line. Never shouting, never rushed, never theatrical; sounds like a real actor in a real studio.
